audit: Bounded publication supplement: new native families and expanded Theseus evidence
integration_rule: Apply replacement records to the existing matching attempt IDs for current coverage; retain original frozen evidence file unchanged. New attempts add observations; plan records must not be pooled as trials.

attempts.model: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (saved request configuration; returned model identity not retained separately)
attempts.evidence_coverage: Newly published archive directly inspected: all 24 dispatch-start records,24 durable parsed results with stop reasons and usage,24 event records,12 episode outcomes and manifest. Repaired requests additionally preserve exact user text. The old hub catalogue was empty; this supplement closes that request/result gap through the separate archive. Records do not retain complete HTTP envelopes or independently returned model identity.
attempts.unit: world-arm episode (12 episodes, six paired scenario/seed worlds; two calls and six decisions per call)
attempts.count_overlap: Terminal, valid, completed and errored may overlap; these are not a partition. Incomplete means started without terminal disposition; unstarted is separate. Completed means protocol endpoint, not scientific success. Do not pool calls, policy rows, paired worlds or replayed prefixes.
attempts.qualification: FAILED joint competence gate, unchanged: explicit-rule accuracy>=0.90 in each scenario/checkpoint and stable learner>=0.75 in every scenario. All schemas valid; no turnover pilot dispatched.
attempts.stalling_behavior: Every call ended with end_turn and a valid six-decision answer. No explicit refusal is recorded. Wrong HOLD/none classifications occur, but these are two-checkpoint batch decisions rather than demonstrated prolonged action loops.

confirmed: Direct packet/answer mismatch: some notebooks misstate visible booleans or add irrelevant criteria despite an explicit governing rule.
Both qualification cohorts produce complete valid outputs but fail action correctness.
plausible: Row/column binding, applying conjunctions, and interference from notebook writing; compound repair did not isolate these.
unknown: Returned model ID is not independently preserved; causality of particular prompt components remains untested.

smallest_diagnostic.test: Offline compare each wrong decision with its row values and governing rule; a separately authorized diagnostic can cross decision-only versus notebook output and atomic versus six-case batches on fresh tasks.
smallest_diagnostic.falsifier: Correct actions rejected by an independent scorer would falsify model-application attribution; the present independent replay found zero disagreements.
smallest_diagnostic.acceptance: Retain the unchanged all-scenario competence gate; any narrower incident-only study needs its own prospective scope and untouched evaluation.

attempts.conclusion_validity: The original failed qualification conclusion is confirmed by complete archived decisions and independent scoring. Initial-versus-repair changes are not a causal formatting estimate because fresh worlds and multiple interface changes differ. No turnover/culture-preservation effect is measured.

attempts.stalling_behavior: Six positive build/alarm observations yield DEFER. These are one-shot task abstentions, not explicit provider refusals or repeated-action stalls. All nine HOLD answers are correct; three bridge PROCEED answers are correct.

confirmed: All18 requests receive valid decisions; six positive build/alarm cases are scored wrong because the returned action is DEFER.
plausible: The generic prompt states a necessary condition without explicitly saying the observation is sufficient; qualification may contain an instrument ambiguity.
unknown: Whether failures arise from that ambiguity or model action competence; the planned Q1 contrast is not yet evidence.

smallest_diagnostic.test: Compare the retained generic necessary-condition packet with a separately authorized, prospectively specified sufficient-condition packet on fresh cases; keep uncertainty controls and criterion order equal.
smallest_diagnostic.falsifier: If DEFER persists when sufficiency is explicit, that wording alone is not sufficient to explain the failure.
smallest_diagnostic.acceptance: Keep the unchanged clean gate and uncertainty controls. Do not advance S1 or count an isolated compatibility success as qualification.

attempts.conclusion_validity: A new genuinely model-executed family with a failed ordinary-task qualification. Complete/schema-valid execution does not qualify the policy comparison. The report candidly identifies plausible task ambiguity rather than treating DEFER as provider refusal.
